newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel a Fator buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel a Fator buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it recommended that investors should buy Copel's preferred "B" shares, which will be offered by Parana state government at an auction on Friday.

-- Parana state, which owns 63.3 percent of the company's voting stake, will offer Copel's eight billion preferred shares, or 8.27 percent of the firm's preferred stake. The auction will take place at the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange at 1330 local/1530 GMT.

-- Analyst Teresinha Moniz said investors by acquiring the PNB shares offered at the auction would have a good opportunity to own part of a company which is well positioned competitively and financially.
-- In addition, she said that the minimum price set for the shares, nine reais per lot of 1,000 shares, is 30 percent less than Copel's common stock, which is also the most traded stock.
-- Copel common shares were traded at 13.20 reais, up 1.54 percent.
